To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
stromal cells are critical for controlling early MCMV infection.

stromal cells in the spleen produce IFN-I that restricts MCMV production, that IFN-I activates NK cells that further restrict MCMV production and that the combined effect of these two IFNs is to prevent the spread of infection until it is eventually cleared.
stromal cells located at the interface of the marginal zone (the spleen) produce type I interferons that are required for the initial innate control of cytomegaloviral replication.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of lymphoid-tissues stromal cells in the innate response to viral infection.
the innate defense to mouse cytomegalivirus.
the innate immune response to mouse cytomegalvirus (MCM) infection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MCMV is a very important source of infection.

the innate response to MCMV is not just the first line of defense against infection, but rather it is the primary line of defense against this pathogen, as it is the only defense that is capable of limiting MCMV replication.
the first burst of MCMV replication is controlled by the IFN-I produced from MZ stromal cell in an lymphotoxin-dependent manner and that this IFN-I is necessary for NK-cell activation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the first innate wave of IFN-I production is critical for the initial control of MCMV infection.
stromal cells are critical in orchestrating the innate defense against CMV.
stromal cells are the primary source of IFN-I during the first wave of infection and that IFN-I is critical for controlling the first burst of MCMV replication.
The main takeaway from our work is that
stromal cells are not simply passive scaffolds that support lymphocyte function, but rather are active players in innate immune defenses.
stromal cells are the key players in the initial control of cytomegaloviruses.
lymphoid tissue stromal cells are critical for orchestrating innate defense to MCV.
